title: Instahyre Jobs Search
description: Type a skill or job title and press Start: you get the newest matching jobs on Instahyre, with posting date, experience range, skills and company size. Every other field is optional. Press Start with the form empty for the newest jobs of every kind.

searchTerms.title: Skills or titles (searchTerms)
searchTerms.description: Type the skills or job titles to find, one per line, for example python or data analyst. A job matches when its title, or one of the skills Instahyre tags it with, has every word of a line: react also finds React Native. Leave it empty to get the newest jobs of every kind. A pasted Instahyre search link works too.

location.title: City or state (location)
location.description: Type the cities or states where the job is, one per line, for example Bangalore, Mumbai, Delhi NCR or Karnataka. Everyday names work too: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Bombay. India finds every job in India; a country such as Singapore finds Instahyre's jobs abroad. Remote or Work from home typed alone asks for Instahyre's Work From Home jobs; next to a city it changes nothing. Leave it empty for anywhere.

experienceYears.title: Experience (experienceYears)
experienceYears.description: Type your years of experience: a number such as 3, a range such as 2-5, 5+ for five or more, or fresher. A job is kept when the years it asks for overlap yours: 3 keeps jobs asking 2-5 or 3-7 years and leaves out 5-9, while 2-5 keeps 5-9 too. One number also goes to Instahyre's own search, which keeps jobs the same way. Leave it empty for every experience.

workType.title: Remote or office (workType)
workType.description: Pick remote for Instahyre's Work From Home jobs, or onsite for jobs in a city. Leave it empty for both. Instahyre marks no job hybrid. Typed words such as wfh or office work too.

postedWithin.title: Posted in the last (postedWithin)
postedWithin.description: Pick how new the jobs must be: posted in the last 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days. Any time, the default, keeps every open job, newest first. Instahyre keeps jobs listed for months and never shows their date in its search; this actor reads it from each job's page. You can also type your own period, such as 2 weeks.

maxJobs.title: Number of jobs (maxJobs)
maxJobs.description: Type how many jobs to get, newest first: 100 by default. Type 0 to get every matching job. Each job is one charged row, so this sets the most a run can cost.

includeDetails.title: Full details (includeDetails)
includeDetails.description: Tick to add the full details of each job: the description as text and HTML, and its company's page on Instahyre: industry, website, LinkedIn, tech stack, benefits and Glassdoor ratings when Instahyre shows them. A job with details costs $1.10 per 1,000 instead of $1.00.

excludeTerms.title: Leave out words (excludeTerms)
excludeTerms.description: Type words that leave a job out when its title has them, one per line, for example senior or manager. Leave it empty to keep every job.

employmentType.title: Job type (employmentType)
employmentType.description: Pick the job type: full-time jobs or internships. Leave it empty for both. Instahyre lists no other job type. Typed words such as internship work too.

companySize.title: Company size (companySize)
companySize.description: Pick the size of the companies: small (up to 50 employees, mostly startups), medium (50 to 200) or large (over 200). Leave it empty for every size. Sizes are Instahyre's own headcount bands.

companies.title: Only these companies (companies)
companies.description: Type company names to search only them, one per line, for example Flipkart or Accenture, or paste a company's Instahyre page (instahyre.com/jobs-at-zomato). Leave it empty to search every company.

jobUrls.title: Job links to check (jobUrls)
jobUrls.description: Paste Instahyre job links to check whether they are still open, one per line, instead of searching. Each link comes back open with the job, closed, or not found.
